svg.title: A kernel exponential family with two centres
svg.desc: Left: two bump-shaped kernel functions centred at two points on a line. Middle: four densities built by choosing weights for the two bumps and exponentiating, so the weights decide how much probability sits near each centre. Right: the plane of the two weights, in which each coloured point is one of the four densities.
svg.text: weights decide where the mass goes
density ∝ exp(θ₁ k(x, c₁) + θ₂ k(x, c₂)) on a fixed interval; colours match between the middle and right panels; grey: both weights zero
